transitions.DESIGNED: → TECHNICALLY_SPECIFIED (architecture + engineering spec complete) OR → ARCHITECTURE_CONCEPT (if a critical design dependency is unresolved, e.g., molecule not designed)
transitions.ARCHITECTURE_CONCEPT: → TECHNICALLY_SPECIFIED (when blocking dependency is resolved, e.g., molecule designed)
transitions.TECHNICALLY_SPECIFIED: → PROTOTYPE_READY (prototype blueprint + reference implementation complete, simulator runs, falsification attempted in software)
transitions.TECHNICALLY_SPECIFIED_DESIGN_FREEZE_PART: → PROTOTYPE_READY (when ALL freeze items resolved — partial freeze is a holding state)
transitions.PROTOTYPE_READY: → BUYER_READY_FOR_TECHNICAL_EVALUATION (external validation handoff folder ready, buyer outreach can begin) OR → VALIDATION_READY (skip buyer outreach, go straight to bench validation)
transitions.BUYER_READY_FOR_TECHNICAL_EVALUATION: → PILOT (buyer agrees to evaluate) OR → FEEDBACK (buyer rejects with structured feedback) OR → VALIDATION_READY (no buyer interest, proceed to academic lab validation)
transitions.INDEPENDENTLY_VALIDATED: → ECONOMICALLY_PROVEN (buyer-specific economics verified via buyer questionnaire)
transitions.PILOT: → TRANSACTION (buyer purchases) OR → FEEDBACK (buyer rejects with structured feedback)
transitions.TRANSACTION: → FEEDBACK (post-transaction buyer data feeds next version)
transitions.FEEDBACK: → VERSION_2 (package updated based on buyer feedback)
